# Jane & Ruby Gillis

- [Jane](../character/jane.md) — Friend of — [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) — old friends who get together · since v2  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) worries about [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaving for [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and asks if she has romantic feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) denies. They talk about [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) before reaffirming their deep, lifelong friendship with each other.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and notices changes in the community during Sunday church, including the marriage of [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) and news that [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) is terminally ill. The next evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) to drop off jelly before going to see Ruby. At the Gillis home, Ruby tries to maintain a lively facade about her social life and future plans despite her deteriorating health.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XI The Round of Life
